title: Composition coherence of proper projection maps
statement: For finite commutative A, proper f:X→Y, g:Y→Z, r:X→Z and hr:r=f;g, put k=rightDerivedLowerShriekCongrIso A hr followed by rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso A f g. For V∈D_A(X), M∈D_A(Z), the canonical projection maps satisfy T_Z(k_V);π_g(FV,M);G(π_f(V,g*M)) = π_r(V,M);Rr_!(T_X(V,l_M));k_(V⊗f*g*M), where l=leftDerivedUpperStarComp A f g r hr. All maps and orientations are precisely those in the attached Lean statement.

source.place: Projection naturality in both diagonal-coordinate triangle computations, specialized to the unit of an arbitrary proper section. Stacks Project: sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0B56; categories.tex, Tag 0DV0.

proof.text:
first take r = f ≫ g. The concrete chosen-compactification projection square says
π_g; G(π_f); E = T(E); π_(fg); H(T(l)), where E is
unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso and l is leftDerivedUpperStarComp. Expanding the three
comparison factors identifies E with the inverse of rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso.
Precompose with T(C.hom), postcompose with C.hom, and cancel inverse pairs to get the
forward square below. Replace projectionMap.app by projectionIso.hom; the latter is the
asIso of exactly that map. For arbitrary r and hr, eliminate hr. The equality comparison
then becomes the identity isomorphism, so its extra factors disappear. This argument
neither specializes to a section nor uses a tensor unit or an identity projection law. The inverse-square cancellation is proved first for an arbitrary bifunctor. The source square uses its local tensor-instance conventions and explicit derived pullbacks. The final conversion to projectionIso and CoordinateTrace.pull is proved by congruence and proof irrelevance, keeping derived constructions folded.

lean.statement:
theorem properProjectionCompositionOfEq {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (r : X ⟶ Z) [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsProper r] (hr : r = f ≫ g)
    (V : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A Z) :
    let k := rightDerivedLowerShriekCongrIso A hr ≪≫ rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso A f g
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).map (k.hom.app V)).app M ≫
      (projectionIso A g ((push A f).obj V)).hom.app M ≫
      (push A g).map ((projectionIso A f V).hom.app ((CoordinateTrace.pull A g).obj M)) =
    (projectionIso A r V).hom.app M ≫
      (push A r).map (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj V).map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g r hr).hom.app M)) ≫
      k.hom.app
      (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj V).obj
        ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f).obj ((CoordinateTrace.pull A g).obj M)))
